findings.reason: the node would dispatch, start the job, report, and leave nothing sampling; the measure that closes §11 would certify zeros over a window that never existed, and the plan must name a durable runner (a systemd user unit like the producer's, an `sbatch` job, or a detached service) whose lifetime is not the run's turn.
findings.text: §11 has the node "start the sampler as one bounded background job (`timeout 86400`, one sample a minute)" and the second node report "over the 24 hours the sampler covered", but a crew worker in print mode gets no turn after its last one and its background tasks are terminated at a 600-second ceiling, so the sampler dies within the first ten minutes of a 1,440-minute window and the report's five figures are taken over minutes, not 24 hours

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `scripts/census/death_census.py` and `carryover_census.py` exist beside the new module's named home; `recovery_review_dispatch._review_in_flight` exists (recovery_review_dispatch.py:491) and does read a pointer's reviewed run through `_review_subject` (recovery_review_dispatch.py:331), which falls through to `_resolved_reviewed_run_id`; `ticker.stream_carries` and `ticker._pane_word` exist.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the gate names five countable figures and a negative control (the instrument over the 48 hours ending 2026-10-23T12:37Z reproduces §1's 24 halted rows with `process_alive: true`), plus a positive/negative pair for the sampler (count 1 with a standing pointer, 0 with the pointer absent); I checked the control's input still exists — `~/.config/reckon/crew/watch/reckon-18dc8a86709b.events` holds 292 records stamped 2026-10-23T10–12 and the streams are not size-rotated (102 MB on disk).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — samples append to `~/.cache/reckon-population/a-live-worker-census/review-missing-samples.jsonl`, whose parent exists and already holds the s3–s17 population dirs, and the report lands at `docs/evidence/fragments/a-live-worker-is-never-drawn-halted/<node-id>.html` (directory present) feeding `docs/evidence/archive/a-live-worker-is-never-drawn-halted-landed.html` (present).
rubric_items.naming: pass — the module name, the sample file and the cache directory are named by what they measure; no plan label, stage id, ticket number or version tag reaches them.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the 24-hour sample §11 needs is taken by a background job started from a worker node, and a worker's background processes end with its turn, so the mechanism cannot produce the window its own done-when measures.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the section declares two nodes, each with one deliverable: the committed instrument+sampler, and the second node's report.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §11 states its ordering in text ("re-run once every other section of this plan has landed and every producer has reloaded onto that code", line 317) and the open followup `f-alwh-005` carries "§11 runs last", so nothing depends on §11 and it points at no wrong node.
